The Role

About the Role

At Kyndryl, we deploy AI innovation where it creates the greatest real-world impact. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate directly with customers to solve complex challenges, shaping solutions that redefine industries. You will be empowered to work at speed, supported by a global AI ecosystem, and play a pivotal role in delivering outcomes that matter. This position operates within our triad delivery model, where engineering, consulting, and product expertise come together to drive transformative results for customers. This is not traditional consulting or pure software engineering; it is a hybrid role designed for the complexities of real-world AI deployment, with accountability for outcomes not just code. You will blend deep engineering expertise with consultative engagement to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business value. Operating in dynamic environments and working closely with customer teams - often on-site - you will scope, prototype, and deploy solutions at pace. Technologies include Generative AI, Agentic AI architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems, with insights continually fed back into Kyndryl s platforms and frameworks to accelerate future deployments. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, excel in direct customer engagement, and aspire to shape the future of enterprise AI, this role is designed for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high quality, fit for purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks.

  • Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development.
  • Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams.

Who You Are

You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences.

Build abstract routing layers for LLMs (switching between OpenAI, Anthropic, and local models seamlessly).
Design agentic workflows that can "reason" about data without hardcoding rules.

This role involves working in teams that use modern agile technical practices - including continuous integration and deployment and fast feedback loops - to deliver timely and pragmatic solutions, as well as helping others to do their jobs in a more effective way.

Responsibilities
As a Gen AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, testing, and deploying GenAI solutions that leverage LLMs and related technologies. You ll work on solutions that incorporate prompt engineering, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and continuous performance monitoring, all while adhering to best practices in software engineering. This role blends data science, data engineering, and MLOps expertise, with a focus on making AI solutions reliable and production-ready.

Required Skills
  • Solution Prototyping & Testing: Rapidly test various models and approaches to determine the best fit for the project without extensive over-investment. Stay updated on LLM advancements (e.g., GPT-3.5 to GPT-4).
  • Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and refine prompts, including creating effective prompt chains and managing prompt versions for optimal results.
  • Model & Prompt Evaluation: Analyze model and prompt performance to ensure reliability. Develop robust testing methodologies, incorporating training and test sets for thorough evaluation.
  • Performance Monitoring: Build pipelines to monitor model responses and track performance metrics in production for ongoing optimization.
  • RAG Architecture Implementation: Design and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. Work with data pipelines, vector databases, and search algorithms. Manage document chunking and embedding selection for optimal context window usage.
  • Data Extraction: Extract data from various sources (e.g., PDF as part of the RAG process.
  • Software Development Best Practices: Employ CI/CD, test-driven development, and sound architectural principles in all GenAI solutions.
  • Evaluation Scripts & Load Testing: Develop tests for the random nature of LLM outputs and conduct load testing to ensure system robustness, even when reliant on third-party APIs.
  • ETL & Traditional Data Management: Build data pipelines to manage and integrate traditional relational data where necessary.

Job Title: Trainer AI, Edge AI & Robotics

AI & Robotics Skilling Centers

Location

Kolkata, with travel as required

Reports to

Practice Head AI, Edge AI & Robotics

Type

Full-time


About the Role

We’re building a nationwide chain of AI & Robotics Skilling Centers and Makers Labs across India, built on a “Skilling to Incubating” model that takes learners from structured training into hands-on prototyping and, eventually, incubation. We’re looking for a Trainer to deliver this curriculum on the ground, teaching core concepts, hand-holding learners through mentored Makers Lab projects, and helping them build real, demonstrable skill rather than passive lecture notes. You’ll work closely with the Practice Head, who sets the curriculum and delivery standards you’ll bring to life in the classroom and lab.


Core Responsibilities Training Delivery

  • Deliver classroom, hybrid, and mentored Makers Lab sessions across assigned capability areas, which may include Edge AI Applications, Computer Vision, Multi-modal AI, Agentic AI, Cloud-based AI, Gen AI & LLMs, or Robotics, as per the curriculum defined by the Practice Head.
  • Hand-hold learners through mentored, hands-on projects rather than deliver lecture-only content, helping candidates move from concept to working prototype.
  • Adapt teaching pace and depth to a mixed pool of learners, ensuring learners with different starting points all reach the required competency bar.
  • Track learner progress, flag gaps early, and provide the extra support or remediation needed to keep learners on pace.

Curriculum Execution & Feedback

  • Deliver the curriculum, tooling, and project briefs as designed, while flagging outdated content, unclear briefs, or gaps observed during delivery back to the Practice Head.
  • Contribute ground-level inputs to keep course content and project briefs current.
  • Maintain session plans, learner assessments, and project documentation to the quality standards set for the network.

Center & Lab Operations

  • Maintain lab and classroom delivery quality in line with the standards set and audited by the Practice Head, so learner experience stays consistent across centers.
  • Use and help maintain GPU-based lab infrastructure and other technical setups needed for sessions.
  • Support onboarding of new trainers at the center where relevant, sharing delivery practices and classroom norms.

Industry Connect

  • Support Makers Lab and incubator-style projects tied to live industry briefs, working with learners to bring these projects to a demonstrable stage.
  • Represent the center credibly to visiting industry partners, guest experts, or academic visitors during sessions or demo days.

Requirements Must-have

  • Preferably 3+ years of hands-on industry or teaching experience in one or more of: Cloud AI, Edge AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Gen AI/LLMs, Agentic AI, or Robotics.
  • Comfort teaching or mentoring, explaining technical concepts clearly to learners at different skill levels.
  • Working fluency with current AI tooling relevant to the assigned capability area(s), not only foundational theory.
  • Willingness to work from a Skilling Center and travel occasionally as required.

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience as a trainer, teaching assistant, bootcamp instructor, or corporate trainer.
  • Robotics-specific experience like robotic arm programming, mechanical or hardware design fundamentals.
  • Experience working with GPU-based lab infrastructure or similar technical lab setups.
  • Exposure to mentoring hackathon, capstone, or incubation-style projects.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who can turn ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes. Youll work across classical ML, statistics, forecasting, NLP, and LLMs, choosing the simplest approach that works—and proving it with data.

  • Work with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and maintain models in production.

Python • SQL • pandas • NumPy • scikit-learn • XGBoost / LightGBM • PyTorch • Hugging Face • Git • MLflow / W&B • AWS / Azure / GCP

SVI is looking for a high-potential IIM graduate to work closely with senior and C-level leadership on strategic research, business improvement, management analysis, and special projects.

The candidate is expected to think, challenge, investigate, connect information, and recommend practical solutions.

  • Research emerging topics such as AI, automation, digital transformation, Industry 4.0, advanced manufacturing, and new business models.

  • Support C-level executives in preparing for strategic discussions and management meetings.

2. Business Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve cost, productivity, quality, processes, organization, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.
  • Analyze current processes and identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Benchmark SVI against leading companies and industry best practices.
  • Develop recommendations together with relevant business functions.
  • Track improvement initiatives and measure business impact.

3. Data & Business Analytics

  • Collect and analyze business and operational data to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Develop analytical models and management dashboards where appropriate.
  • Translate data into business insights and recommendations.
  • Support management with fact-based analysis rather than assumptions.

4. AI & Digital Transformation

  • Research how AI and digital technologies can be applied across SVI.
  • Identify potential opportunities for AI-enabled productivity, automation, decision support, and process improvement.
  • Benchmark how leading global companies are using AI and digital technologies.
  • Work with relevant functions to assess potential use cases and business value.

5. Special Projects

  • Support C-level executives on strategic and confidential projects.
  • Conduct analysis for new business opportunities, investments, organizational changes, and transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects involving Operations, Engineering, Finance, Sales, HR, IT, and other functions.
  • Take ownership of selected projects from research analysis recommendation implementation results.

6. Executive Communication

  • Prepare high-quality presentations for senior management.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly and logically.
  • Communicate with stakeholders across different functions and levels.
  • Be comfortable asking difficult questions and challenging existing assumptions respectfully.

Education

  • MBA / Postgraduate degree from IIM, preferably from a leading IIM.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Analytics, or a related field.
  • Fresh IIM graduates are welcome.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Excellent research skills.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Ability to work with data and convert it into meaningful business insights.
  • Strong business understanding and commercial awareness.
  • Interest in AI, digital transformation, technology, and manufacturing.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate with senior executives with maturity and confidence.
  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Personal Characteristics

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Highly curious naturally wants to understand why things happen.
  • Analytical uses facts and data to form conclusions.
  • Business-minded understands the impact on cost, revenue, productivity, customers, and people.
  • Proactive – does not wait to be told every step.
  • Mature and confident – comfortable working with senior leaders.
  • Structured thinker – can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear approach.
  • Innovative – interested in finding better ways of working.
  • Humble and collaborative – able to work with people across all levels.
  • Execution-oriented – not only recommends ideas but follows through to results.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

  • Independently conduct research and present meaningful insights to senior management.
  • Identify business improvement opportunities and quantify their potential impact.
  • Support C-level executives with high-quality analysis and recommendations.
  • Lead selected cross-functional improvement projects.
  • Develop a strong understanding of SVI's business, customers, operations, and competitive environment.
  • Become a trusted "thought partner" to management.

Senior Software Engineer, AI & Data

Location: Bangalore, India


Employment type: Direct Agreement with WALT US (no local contract)

Experience: 4-7 years

Company: thewalt.ai


#AIEngineer #DataEngineering #SQL #Python #Snowflake #dbt #AgenticAI #DistributedSystems #SemanticLayer


About WALT


WALT (thewalt.ai) is building the world's first Autonomous Data Engineer: a platform of five specialised, collaborating AI agents (Ingestor, Transformer, Reasoner, Operator, and Governor) that manage an entire data platform end-to-end, covering ingestion, transformation, analytics, monitoring, and governance.


What makes WALT different is how it answers business questions. Instead of relying on an LLM to generate SQL on the fly, our Reasoner agent uses deterministic analytical inference over a Data Context Graph (ReasonBase), a context layer that maps business vocabulary to the underlying data. The result is the same trusted answer, every time. That reliability is why regulated, data-intensive customers in financial services, retail, and advertising trust us with their analytics: they get auditability, compliance, and consistency, not stochastic guesses.

We're an early-stage, fast-moving team obsessed with correctness, security, and delivering analytics people can actually rely on.


The Role


We're looking for an AI-native Senior Software Engineer to help build the data and analytical products at the core of WALT, the systems that turn raw, messy enterprise data into trusted, deterministic answers at scale.


This is a hands-on builder-and-coder role, not a purely advisory or architect one. You'll design, implement, and evaluate core components of how our agents reason over data, build the platform that makes that reasoning fast, correct, and governable, and go deep to prove out the hard parts in code. You'll be a strong individual contributor and a key technical voice as WALT scales, a force multiplier for the engineering team.


If you've spent your career building analytical and data products (semantic layers, query/inference engines, BI and analytics platforms, or large-scale data pipelines) and you want to build a category-defining product hands-on, this is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate core components of WALT's analytical and data products: the context layer (ReasonBase), the deterministic inference engine, and the data platform the agents operate on.
  • Build systems that produce correct, reproducible, and auditable analytical results across large, heterogeneous enterprise datasets.
  • Contribute to the foundational technical decisions: data modelling and the semantic/knowledge graph, query and inference execution, storage and compute, orchestration across the agent framework, and the boundaries between neural and symbolic components.
  • Partner with FDEs and founding engineers to translate ambiguous customer problems across industries into robust, scalable implementations.
  • Uphold and raise engineering standards for performance, reliability, security, and compliance (auditability, lineage, governance).
  • Own critical services end-to-end, writing reference implementations and reviewing important code.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to design and code reviews as the team grows.

Core experience

  • 4+ years building production software, with meaningful time spent on data-intensive and analytical products (analytics/BI platforms, semantic layers, query or inference engines, data warehouses/lakes, or large-scale data pipelines).
  • A track record of owning and shipping complex components or services end-to-end, seen running in production, ideally at a data or product company (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake).
  • Solid foundation in distributed systems and data engineering: data modelling, query processing, storage/compute trade-offs, and building for correctness and scale.
  • Strong grasp of the analytics stack: SQL and modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt), and orchestration.
  • Fluency in one or more backend languages used for data systems (e.g., Python, Java/Scala, Go, or Rust).
  • Ability to reason rigorously about data correctness, reproducibility, and auditability. You care that the answer is right and explainable, not just fast.
  • Hands-on experience (or strong, demonstrated interest) building with agentic AI: designing, orchestrating, and shipping systems built on LLM/agent frameworks and multiple collaborating agents.

How you work

  • Hands-on: you design by building and earn technical trust through code and prototypes.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and an early-stage pace. You empathise with customers and go deep to solve their real problems, turning a fuzzy need into shipped software rather than a slide.
  • A clear communicator who collaborates well and helps level up the engineers around you.

Nice to have

  • Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or symbolic/rule-based reasoning.
  • Experience with ML/LLM systems (neuro-symbolic approaches); ability to train or fine-tune models.
  • Background delivering software into regulated or data-sensitive industries (financial services, retail/adtech, healthcare) with real compliance, governance, and security requirements.

Why WALT

  • Help build a genuinely new category, the autonomous data engineer, from an early and influential seat.
  • Work on hard, meaningful problems where correctness and trust are the product, not an afterthought.
  • Direct impact with enterprise customers in high-stakes, regulated domains.
  • A team that values reliability, security, and doing the hard engineering right.

Learn more at https://www.thewalt.ai

  • Hands-on: you design by building and earn technical trust through code and prototypes.

  • Background delivering software into regulated or data-sensitive industries (financial services, retail/adtech, healthcare) with real compliance, governance, and security requirements.

title: AI/ML Engineer
jobDescription:
Role

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will work closely with the Founding AI/ML Tech Lead to research, design, develop and deploy AI-powered applications.

This is a hands-on role where you will have the opportunity to work across the full AI product lifecycle from research and experimentation to prototyping, development, testing and production deployment.

You will be encouraged to experiment with emerging AI technologies and contribute ideas that can become commercially valuable products and proprietary technology.



Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design and develop AI/ML solutions for real-world enterprise use cases.
  • Develop applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.
  • Build and optimise RAG-based applications, AI agents and intelligent workflows.
  • Work with embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering and model evaluation.
  • Experiment with different AI models and approaches to improve accuracy, performance and cost.
  • Develop AI pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
  • Evaluate and benchmark AI models and solutions.

Product Development

  • Convert business and technical requirements into working AI solutions.
  • Build prototypes, PoCs and MVPs quickly.
  • Develop reusable AI components and services.
  • Contribute to taking successful prototypes into production.
  • Build APIs and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise AI applications in production.

Data & Engineering

  • Work with structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Develop data preparation and processing pipelines.
  • Work with relational and vector databases.
  • Develop and consume REST APIs.
  • Follow software engineering best practices, including Git, testing, documentation and code reviews.
  • Support cloud deployment and monitoring of AI applications.

Research & Innovation

  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and ML technologies.
  • Evaluate new models, frameworks and tools for potential commercial use.
  • Participate in internal research and experimentation.
  • Identify opportunities to develop differentiated technology and intellectual property.
  • Contribute to technical papers, prototypes, internal frameworks and proof-of-concept solutions where appropriate.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the AI/ML Tech Lead and software engineers.
  • Participate in technical discussions and architecture reviews.

Document approaches, experiments and lessons learned.


Preferred candidate profile

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in AI/ML, software engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Good understanding of machine learning and modern AI techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
  • Practical experience with one or more of:
    • RAG
    • LLM APIs
    • Embeddings
    • Vector databases
    • Prompt engineering
    • AI agents / agentic workflows
    • NLP
    • Model evaluation
  • Experience working with APIs and databases.
  • Familiarity with Git and software development practices.
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to learn rapidly and work independently.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or open-source LLMs.
  • Experience with Hugging Face and open-source models.
  • Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience with Docker and CI/CD.
  • Experience with document AI / intelligent document processing.
  • Experience integrating AI with ERP or enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Salesforce.
  • Exposure to AI security, governance, evaluation or observability.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning or parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:

Curious genuinely interested in understanding how new AI technologies work.

Hands-on willing to build, experiment, test and learn rather than relying purely on theory.

Product-minded – interested in solving customer problems, not just building technology for its own sake.

Entrepreneurial – comfortable working in an early-stage environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

Analytical – able to compare different models and approaches objectively.

Collaborative – comfortable working closely with senior technical and business stakeholders.

Growth-oriented – excited by the opportunity to learn rapidly and grow with an early-stage AI company.


Perks and benefits

Why Join Us?

You will be joining the company at an early stage and will have a genuine opportunity to influence the technology and products we build.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Work with the latest Generative AI and LLM technologies.
  • Build AI solutions from the ground up.
  • Work on challenging enterprise business problems.
  • Contribute to proprietary AI technology and IP.
  • Work directly with senior technical leadership.
  • Gain exposure to customers in India, the UK, Europe and Americas.
  • Develop skills across AI research, product development and production engineering.
  • Grow rapidly within a young AI company.

Compensation

Competitive salary + performance incentive, with potential ESOP/equity participation for exceptional candidates.

title: Founding AI/ML Tech Lead
jobDescription:
The Role

As our Founding AI/ML Tech Lead, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the technical direction of the company.

You will work closely with the Founder to identify commercially valuable AI opportunities, evaluate emerging technologies, design AI solutions, build prototypes and lead the development of production-ready products.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, experimenting with new AI technologies and turning ideas into working products.

You will initially be both a technical leader and hands-on engineer, with responsibility for establishing our AI architecture, development standards and engineering practices.


Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Architecture

  • Define the technical architecture and AI strategy for the company's products.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, frameworks and platforms.
  • Select appropriate LLMs, foundation models, open-source models and supporting technologies based on cost, performance, security and business requirements.
  • Design scalable AI/ML architectures for enterprise applications.
  • Develop approaches for RAG, AI agents, workflow automation, document intelligence and other enterprise AI use cases.
  • Establish best practices for AI evaluation, reliability, security and performance.

Product & R&D

  • Lead the research, prototyping and development of new AI solutions.
  • Convert business problems into practical AI solutions and technical specifications.
  • Build rapid proofs of concept and minimum viable products (MVPs).
  • Design and develop proprietary AI workflows, algorithms, tools and reusable components.
  • Identify opportunities for creating differentiated technology and intellectual property.
  • Continuously evaluate new AI research, models and tools and determine their practical commercial application.
  • Develop prototypes into reliable production solutions.

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a small team of AI/ML and software engineers.
  • Establish coding, testing, documentation, deployment and engineering standards.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and code reviews.
  • Establish CI/CD, version control, testing and monitoring practices.
  • Make appropriate build-vs-buy technology decisions.
  • Help recruit and develop the initial engineering team.

Enterprise Integration

  • Design integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems, APIs and data sources.
  • Work with technologies such as ERP, CRM, databases, document repositories and business workflow systems.
  • Ensure AI solutions can operate securely within enterprise environments.
  • Consider data privacy, access control, security, auditability and compliance from the design stage.

Client Engagement

  • Participate in technical discussions with prospective customers.
  • Understand customer business problems and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions and AI solution assessments.
  • Demonstrate prototypes and AI capabilities to clients.
  • Support solution proposals, estimates and technical documentation.


Preferred candidate profile

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 3-5 plus years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or a closely related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications.
  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Good understanding of modern Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Practical experience with technologies such as:
    • RAG
    • Vector databases
    • Embeddings
    • Prompt engineering
    • AI agents / agentic workflows
    • LLM orchestration
    • Model evaluation
    • AI application development
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Experience designing and deploying production-grade applications.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and API design.
  • Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Good understanding of Git, CI/CD, testing and deployment practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to independently research new technologies and turn them into practical solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience integrating AI with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce or similar platforms.
  • Experience in Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, ERP or other enterprise business processes.
  • Experience building AI-powered workflow automation.
  • Experience with document AI / intelligent document processing.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, observability and governance.
  • Experience with fine-tuning or adapting open-source models.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker and modern cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience taking an AI prototype from PoC through production.
  • Understanding of intellectual property, patents or technology commercialisation.

Technical Environment

You may work with technologies including:

Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript

AI/ML: LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, embeddings, agentic AI, NLP, ML frameworks

Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks

Data: PostgreSQL, vector databases, data pipelines and APIs

Cloud: AWS / Azure / GCP

DevOps: Git, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring and cloud deployment

The exact technology stack will evolve as the company develops, so a strong ability to learn and evaluate new technologies is more important than experience with a particular framework.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Hands-on comfortable writing code and building solutions rather than only managing teams.
  • Product-minded understands that technology must solve a real customer problem.
  • Curious actively follows developments in AI and experiments with new approaches.
  • Commercially aware – able to assess whether an AI solution has genuine business value.
  • Entrepreneurial – comfortable working in an early-stage environment with ambiguity.
  • Pragmatic – knows when to use existing technology rather than reinventing it.
  • A strong communicator – able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A mentor – capable of building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

Perks and benefits


Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join an AI company at an early stage and have significant influence over its technology and product direction.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Shape the company's AI technology strategy.
  • Build AI products from the ground up.
  • Work on commercially meaningful enterprise AI problems.
  • Develop proprietary technology and potentially protectable IP.
  • Build and lead the initial AI engineering team.
  • Work with customers in India, the UK, Europe and Americas.
  • Work closely with the Founder and influence key business and technology decisions.
  • Grow into a senior technology leadership position as the company scales.

Compensation

Competitive salary + performance incentive + potential ESOP/equity participation, depending on experience and the candidate's contribution to the company's growth.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Pick a track: Platform (Python services, connectors, access control), AI (generation pipeline, prompts, evaluations, MCP tools), or Applications (building and testing real applications on Supero).
  • Own and ship a small, real production feature. Interns work on production capabilities rather than isolated training projects.
  • Build backend and AI-enabled capabilities using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go.
  • Work on data models, APIs, connectors, authorization, multi-tenancy, AI workflows, testing, debugging, and platform reliability.
  • Write concise design notes, participate in engineering/design reviews, test failure scenarios, and contribute to root-cause analysis when things go wrong.
  • Build realistic applications with roles, permissions, tenant boundaries, and unhappy paths, and report platform issues clearly and constructively.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Students and new graduates who have built real software. Previous internship experience or a recognizable company name on your CV is not required.
  • Comfortable writing code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go and explaining the decisions behind it.
  • Has built something beyond a classroom exercise: a side project, college system, lab tool, open-source contribution, or application used by others.
  • Interested in AI-assisted software development and willing to work with LLMs, MCP, and production AI engineering practices.
  • Understands, or is eager to learn, data modeling, APIs, authorization, multi-tenancy, testing, debugging, and production reliability.
  • Thinks critically about their own work, can explain trade-offs and mistakes, and is willing to identify problems in the tools they use.

Perks and Benefits

  • Paid internship with competitive compensation and potential conversion to a full-time role.
  • Stock options for eligible hires.
  • Remote opportunity with real production ownership from early in the internship.
  • Direct technical mentorship and reviews with the engineers and leaders you would work with.
  • No algorithm-puzzle or whiteboard-trivia interview process; evaluation focuses on real systems, engineering judgment, and work you have built.
  • Every application and build submission is reviewed by a person; no automated screening decision.

About Supero
Supero is an agent-native application development platform for building production-grade enterprise software from prompt to production. The platform combines full-stack application generation with data modeling, APIs, services and workflows, connectors, access control, multi-tenancy, AI capabilities, MCP-based development, testing, and deployment.
The internship is designed around real ownership. Intern-scoped work can include platform capabilities such as connector controls, field-level access testing, AI tooling, and safeguards that catch problems in generated applications before they reach production.


Build Something on Supero - First Round
For interns and new graduates, the first-round evaluation is based on something you built. You can either build a small application on Supero or submit an existing project. Both routes are scored using the same engineering criteria.
If you build on Supero, we prefer that you use MCP from your own AI editor, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot. App Studio also works, but MCP is closest to how the platform is intended to be used.


What to Build

  • Keep the scope small: approximately 3 - 5 entities, 2 roles, and at least one meaningful failure or edge case.
  • Enable multi-tenancy when generating the application. It is currently a generation-time flag that defaults to off, and we evaluate whether your model survives a second tenant.
  • Aim for about 90 minutes. Four hours is the hard cap; spending longer does not improve your score.
  • Model something you understand: a domain you have worked in, a system that annoyed you, or another small idea you can explain confidently.
  • Visual polish is not the goal. Be prepared to explain every important decision in the application.

What to Submit

  • A screenshot of the application's landing page.
  • The live application URL.
  • Optionally, a link to the source in your own GitHub repository.
  • A short explanation of what you modeled and one decision you reversed.
  • Two observations about Supero itself: what you liked most and what you would improve.

What We Actually Score
We evaluate whether the data model survives a second tenant, whether roles and permissions make sense, whether you handled a state with no happy path, and whether you noticed something wrong with the platform and explained it clearly. A small, defensible three-entity application with a sharp bug report can score better than a twenty-screen application that only works on the happy path.
A completed Supero build replaces the initial screening conversation and separate take-home exercise. Candidates who move forward go directly to the technical stage.


Alternative Route - Submit Something You Already Built
You may submit an existing project built with any stack, from any domain or time period, together with a short explanation of the data model and one decision you would now reverse. This route is scored using the same criteria and is not treated as a lesser option.


Hiring Process

  • Step 1 - Apply / submit your build. A person reads every application. If you submit the build challenge, that is reviewed first.
  • Step 2 - 30-minute conversation with the person who would manage you, focused on what you have built. This step is skipped if you submitted a Supero build.
  • Step 3 - 90-minute technical session: a real problem from our backlog or a walkthrough of your build. No algorithm puzzles or whiteboard trivia.
  • Step 4 - Two 45-minute conversations with people you would work with, including a design-review simulation.
  • Step 5 - Founder conversation, followed by the offer decision. We tell you where you stand after each stage.

Fine Print

  • You own what you build. Your intellectual property and copyright remain yours; Supero receives only the limited permission needed to review the submission as part of your application.
  • Do not submit an employer's confidential information, proprietary code or data, or real personal data belonging to anyone. Use invented test data.
  • Time-box the exercise: aim for 90 minutes and do not exceed four hours.
  • We delete our copy of the submission and any repository access granted to us within 90 days of a final decision, or sooner on request.
  • A human scores every submission; no automated screening system decides whether you move forward.
  • Security testing is limited to your own project and tenants you created. Do not probe other accounts, Supero infrastructure, authentication systems, or anything you were not given permission to test. Report broader security findings to security@supero.dev.
  • No credit card is required for the challenge account. The account includes an allowance intended to cover the exercise, and submitted URLs are intended to remain live for at least 30 days.
  • Participation in the hiring process does not create an obligation for either party to hire, accept employment, or pay for a submission beyond any explicitly stated internship compensation.

Find Us / Candidate Resources

  • MCP: https://www.supero.dev/mcp
  • Create an account: https://app.supero.dev/register
  • GitHub: https://github.com/supero-platform/supero-apps
  • LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/supero-dev/

jobDescription:
About the Role


We are an AI-native software and consulting company that works with businesses to identify operational problems and build AI, automation, and custom software solutions around them.


We are looking for a **Business Development Manager** who can help us build our outbound sales engine from the ground up.


This is not a traditional lead-generation role where your job is to download thousands of contacts from Apollo and send generic emails.


You will be responsible for figuring out:


* Which industries and ICPs we should target

* Which companies within those markets are worth approaching

* Who the right decision-makers are

* What messaging and offers resonate with them

* Which outbound channels work best

* How to consistently generate qualified sales conversations


You will work directly with the founder and will have significant ownership over the company's GTM strategy.


## What You Will Do


### Build Outbound Pipeline


Own outbound prospecting across channels including:


* Cold calling

* Cold email

* LinkedIn outreach

* Account-based prospecting

* Follow-ups and multi-channel sequences


Your objective is not simply to book meetings.


Your objective is to generate **qualified sales conversations and real business opportunities**.


Test Different ICPs and Markets


We will continuously test different industries and customer segments.


You will be responsible for:


* Researching industries and customer segments

* Developing ICP hypotheses

* Identifying relevant companies and decision-makers

* Creating and launching outbound campaigns

* Testing different messaging and offers

* Measuring results

* Killing campaigns that do not work

* Doubling down on campaigns that show traction


You should be comfortable operating in an environment where the perfect sales playbook does not already exist.


Run Modern Outbound


We do not believe that simply scraping leads from Apollo and sending thousands of generic emails is an effective GTM strategy.


You should understand concepts such as:


* Account research

* Segmentation

* Buying signals

* Trigger-based outreach

* Personalized messaging

* Multi-channel prospecting

* AI-assisted research

* CRM and pipeline management


You should constantly think:


**Why should this specific prospect care about what we are offering right now?**


Cold Calling


Cold calling is an important part of this role.


You should be comfortable:


* Calling prospects directly

* Starting cold conversations

* Getting through gatekeepers

* Understanding the prospect's business problem

* Handling objections

* Identifying the right decision-maker

* Converting relevant conversations into meetings


If you are uncomfortable picking up the phone and speaking to prospects, this role will not be a good fit.


Use AI in Your GTM Workflow


We are an AI-native company and expect our GTM team to operate similarly.


You should be comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI systems for:


* Account research

* Prospect qualification

* Company research

* Personalization

* Market analysis

* Message iteration

* Call preparation

* Campaign analysis

* Workflow automation


You do not need to know every AI tool available today.


However, you should understand how to use AI to become significantly more effective at sales and business development.


Generate Market Intelligence


Your job is not only to generate meetings.


Through outbound conversations and campaign data, you should also help us understand:


* Which industries have the strongest pain points

* Which problems prospects care about

* Which decision-makers respond

* Common objections

* Buying triggers

* Why campaigns succeed or fail

* How our positioning should evolve

* Which ICPs we should pursue further


The insights you generate will directly influence the company's GTM strategy.


What We Are Looking For


You should have:


* 36 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Outbound Sales, or International Sales

* Experience selling **IT services, software development services, AI/automation solutions, technology consulting, or similar B2B technology services**

* Strong cold-calling experience

* Experience generating outbound pipeline

* Strong written and spoken English

* Experience working with international prospects, preferably the US market

* Good understanding of consultative / solution selling

* Strong research and analytical skills

* Experience working with CRM and prospecting tools

* Ability to operate independently and take ownership

* Comfort working directly with founders

* High agency and bias toward action


Good to Have


Experience with:


* AI / Generative AI / Automation services

* IT consulting or software development companies

* US-market outbound

* Apollo

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* Clay

* HubSpot or similar CRMs

* Cold email tools

* Email deliverability

* AI-assisted GTM workflows


This Role Is Not For You If


* Your outbound strategy is simply downloading lists and mass-emailing them

* You only want inbound leads handed to you

* You are unwilling to cold call

* You measure success primarily by the number of emails sent

* You need a mature sales playbook before you can operate

* You have no experience selling technology or services

* You are primarily looking for a people-management role


What Success Looks Like


Within the first few months, you should be able to:


* Build a structured outbound process

* Test multiple ICPs and campaigns

* Consistently generate qualified conversations

* Identify which industries and messages are working

* Build a repeatable prospecting process

* Provide clear market insights based on real conversations

* Create a predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities


The long-term objective is simple:


Build a repeatable outbound engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline for the company.


This is a high-ownership individual-contributor role.


If you enjoy experimenting with markets, talking to prospects, building outbound systems, and figuring out what actually makes customers buy, you will have significant ownership here.

The company builds n8n workflows and AI agents that take repetitive office work away from Dutch SME clients, so those clients can spend their time on growth instead of admin. Next to the client work there is AIOS, the in-house platform the team runs on. It already handles feedback automatically and is growing into a real client portal.


Your first project is the client ticket flow inside AIOS. Clients use it, so it has to work without fail. After that you build and maintain the links between n8n, Supabase and external systems, and you pick up internal automations wherever the team runs into errors or delays.


01 WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build features in Next.js and TypeScript for AIOS and for client projects
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows and the links between n8n, Supabase and external systems
  • Turn existing n8n workflows into custom code where that runs faster or cheaper
  • Own Supabase: schemas, RLS policies and migrations, all version controlled in the repo
  • Make what you build testable and check it yourself before it goes live
  • Ship to production through pull requests
  • Gather and sharpen the specification before you start building
  • Work carefully with client data, because it is real client data in these systems

02 HOW WE BUILD

We build with AI tooling every day. Claude Code, Codex and whatever comes next. That is the standard here, not an experiment.

The condition is simple. You can explain, review and correct every line in the repo, whether you typed it or a model did. Speed comes from AI. Quality comes from you.

Testing is not formalised here yet. Setting that up is part of the job, starting with the code you write yourself.


03 THE STACK

  • JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Next.js
  • n8n
  • Supabase, with schemas, RLS policies and migrations in the repo
  • Vercel, with preview deploys as staging
  • Git, with pull requests reviewed by the founder
  • Claude Code, Codex and comparable AI development tools

No own servers and no Docker. Everything runs on Vercel.


04 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Several years of hands-on Next.js and TypeScript in production
  • Experience with n8n or comparable workflow automation
  • Strong Supabase or Postgres. You write your own schemas, RLS policies and migrations and keep them version controlled, instead of clicking them together in a dashboard
  • Daily use of AI development tools, with you staying accountable for whatever ends up in the repo
  • You work independently. The founder reviews your pull requests at a high level. He is technical, but not a full time developer, so nobody is looking over your shoulder
  • You ask about the specification early instead of guessing at what was meant
  • A security minded way of working. You work with the anon key, production keys stay with the founder
  • You communicate clearly in English, including when something is not finished yet

05 PRACTICAL

  • Fulltime, 40 hours per week
  • Working from Nordavo's office in Indiranagar, Bangalore, alongside an international team
  • You work with the Dutch team during their working day, so a good part of your hours overlaps with the Netherlands
  • Compensation depending on experience and level, discussed in the first call

WHAT YOU GET

Compensation is based on experience and level, discussed in the first call, alongside a complete benefits package designed to give you flexibility, ownership and room to grow.


Flexibility & Comfort

  • Flexible starting hours between 10:00 and 12:00
  • Flexible paid leave
  • A regular Monday to Friday schedule with no weekend work
  • Fixed travel allowance
  • Fixed lunch allowance
  • Monthly team lunches and social activities
  • A company laptop and your own dedicated desk
  • A modern office in Indiranagar, Bangalore

A Modern Way of Working

  • An AI first working environment
  • Access to modern AI and cloud tools
  • Exposure to European clients and international projects
  • Short development cycles and direct feedback
  • The opportunity to see your work used by thousands of professionals

Freedom & Growth

  • Direct contact with the founders
  • Freedom and responsibility within your role
  • Room to contribute and implement your own ideas
  • Personal learning and development opportunities
  • Clear career growth opportunities as Nordavo expands
  • Significant technical ownership over the platform and its architecture

descriptionFromApi:
We're hiring a Data Engineer to build the data backbone that everything else in the company runs on from executive dashboards to machine learning models to customer-facing analytics. Every AI initiative, every business decision, and every product feature increasingly depends on clean, reliable, well-governed data arriving where it needs to be, on time. That's the job: designing and running the pipelines and infrastructure that make that possible, day in and day out.

This role sits at the foundation of the data organization. You'll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and backend engineers, but your core responsibility is distinct from theirs — you build and maintain the systems that move, transform, store, and secure data at scale, so that everyone downstream can trust what they're working with.


Roles & Responsibilities


Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from multiple sources — databases, APIs, event streams, third-party platforms — into centralized data stores.
  • Write efficient, well-tested, production-grade code (primarily Python and SQL) for data transformation and validation logic.
  • Build and orchestrate workflows using tools like Apache Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent schedulers, ensuring pipelines are idempotent, monitored, and recoverable.
  • Handle both batch and real-time/streaming data processing needs (Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Streaming) depending on project requirements.

Data Architecture & Warehousing

  • Design and evolve data models (star schema, snowflake schema, or data vault) that balance query performance with long-term maintainability.
  • Build and optimize data warehouses/lakehouses on platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks.
  • Partition, index, and tune large-scale datasets for cost-efficient, fast querying by downstream teams.
  • Own schema evolution and versioning as business requirements change, without breaking downstream consumers.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Implement automated data quality checks, validation rules, and alerting so bad data is caught before it reaches dashboards or models.
  • Maintain clear documentation of data lineage — where data comes from, how it's transformed, and who consumes it.
  • Apply data governance and access-control best practices, especially for sensitive or regulated data (PII, financial data).
  • Work with compliance/security teams to ensure data handling meets relevant regulatory standards.

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure feature pipelines are reliable and reproducible for model training.
  • Support analysts and business stakeholders by making data self-serve wherever possible, reducing repetitive ad-hoc requests.
  • Continuously monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and perform root-cause analysis on data incidents.
  • Evaluate and recommend new data tools/platforms as the data stack scales.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • 2–6 years of experience building production data pipelines, with strong command of SQL and Python.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one distributed processing framework (Spark) and one orchestration tool (Airflow or equivalent).
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its data services.
  • Understanding of data modeling principles and experience with a modern cloud data warehouse.
  • Strong debugging instincts — comfortable diagnosing why a pipeline silently produced wrong numbers, not just why it crashed.
  • Bonus: experience with streaming data (Kafka), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), or dbt for transformation management.

Growth Path: Data Engineer Senior Data Engineer Data Platform Lead/Architect Head of Data Engineering


Perks & Benefits: Health insurance, performance bonus, cloud certification reimbursement, hybrid work options, learning budget for data tooling courses.


Salary variants by level:

  • Fresher (0–2 yrs): 5,00,000 – 9,00,000
  • Senior (7+ yrs): 40,00,000 – 80,00,000+

descriptionFromApi:
we are looking for an AI/Machine Learning Engineer who can take models from a research notebook to a live, production-grade system that real users depend on. This is not a research-only role you'll spend as much time on deployment, monitoring, and scaling as you do on model architecture. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, software engineering, and applied AI, embedded in a cross-functional team that ships AI-powered features on a regular release cycle.

You will own the full lifecycle of machine learning systems: understanding the business problem, framing it as an ML/AI task, sourcing and preparing data, building and validating models, deploying them into production, and then continuously monitoring and improving them based on real-world performance. Increasingly, this also means working with large language models — fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt optimization, and evaluating when a generative AI approach is the right tool versus a traditional ML model.

Roles & Responsibilities

Model Development

  • Design, train, and validate machine learning and deep learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, NLP, or computer vision use cases depending on team focus.
  • Build and fine-tune LLM-based solutions using techniques such as RAG, prompt engineering, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT).
  • Run structured experiments, track metrics rigorously, and choose models based on defensible evaluation criteria rather than intuition.
  • Stay hands-on with emerging architectures (transformers, diffusion models, agentic frameworks) and evaluate their fit for business problems.

Production Engineering & MLOps

  • Build reproducible, version-controlled ML pipelines covering data ingestion, feature engineering, training, and deployment.
  • Deploy models into production using containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) and serving frameworks (FastAPI, TorchServe, Triton, or similar).
  • Set up model monitoring for drift, latency, and accuracy degradation, and build automated retraining triggers where appropriate.
  • Own cost and performance optimization for models running at scale, including GPU utilization and inference latency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with data engineers to ensure clean, well-structured, and timely data pipelines feed your models.
  • Partner with product managers to translate ambiguous business goals into measurable ML objectives and success metrics.
  • Communicate model capabilities, limitations, and risk trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders — including where a model might fail and why.
  • Mentor junior team members on ML best practices, code quality, and experiment design.

Governance & Responsible AI

  • Apply basic model governance practices: documentation, bias/fairness checks, and reproducibility standards.
  • Ensure data privacy and security compliance when handling sensitive training data.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • 2–6 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML/AI models in a production environment (not just academic or Kaggle projects).
  • Strong Python skills and fluency with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Practical experience with LLM tooling — LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), or similar — is highly valued.
  • Solid grounding in statistics, linear algebra, and core ML algorithms; you should be able to explain why a model works, not just that it works.
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or GCP Vertex AI) and containerization.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where the "right" approach isn't always obvious upfront.
  • Bonus: contributions to open-source ML projects, published research, or a strong portfolio of deployed AI projects.

Growth Path: ML Engineer Senior ML Engineer Staff/Lead ML Engineer or ML Architect Head of AI/ML

Perks & Benefits: Health insurance, performance bonus, ESOPs (if startup), certification and conference budget, flexible/hybrid work, dedicated GPU/compute access for experimentation.

Salary variants by level:

  • Fresher (0–1 yr): 6,00,000 – 14,00,000
  • Senior (6–10 yrs): 35,00,000 – 70,00,000+

Candidates should have a strong portfolio demonstrating product-based brand creatives, packaging, catalogues, e-commerce creatives, advertising, social media and video/motion work.

We are looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer who can help us build the core technology behind these systems.

You will design and build systems that can ingest, understand, extract information from, and reason over large volumes of documents and unstructured data.   • Build systems for ingesting PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, images, emails, and other unstructured data.
  • Develop document parsing, OCR, classification, extraction, chunking, indexing, and retrieval workflows.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Build monitoring, evaluation, logging, and quality-control systems for AI applications.
  • Optimize systems for accuracy, speed, scalability, and cost.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and data-quality problems.
  • Work closely with company leadership to turn product ideas into production systems.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering and coding ability.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with Python and/or another modern backend language.
  • Hands-on experience building production AI/ML applications.
  • Experience with document ingestion, document processing, or document intelligence.
  • Experience working with PDFs, OCR, document parsing, extraction, or unstructured data.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and AI application architecture.
  • Experience building APIs and backend services.
  • Strong full-stack development experience.
  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Strong Git, testing, debugging, and software-development practices.
  • Ability to take ownership of projects and work independently.

Highly Valuable

  • Experience with Unstructured, LlamaParse, Docling, Apache Tika, PyMuPDF, or similar document-processing technologies.
  • Experience with AWS Textract, Google Document AI, Azure Document Intelligence, Tesseract, or similar OCR/document-AI systems.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other frontier LLM APIs.
  • Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, or other vector databases.
  • Experience building AI agents and multi-step AI workflows.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Docker and CI/CD.
  • Experience designing systems that process large document collections.
  • Experience optimizing AI systems for latency, cost, accuracy, and reliability.

The Short Version
You create AI videos that people swear were filmed by a real crew - and then build the
system that lets entire teams recreate that quality at scale.
The Longer Version
AI video creation is changing faster than anyone can keep up. Most of it still looks
unmistakably AI - faces drift, lighting falls apart, continuity breaks. Your job is to make people
forget they're watching something AI-generated. You'll do this on Frameo.ai, Dashverse's AI
content production platform used by production houses, D2C brands, and ecommerce
companies. First with your own hands, then by turning your method into a pipeline a client
can run on Frameo without you in the room.
You will sit with a client, figure out what they actually need (a brand's ad format, a
training-narration style, an episodic drama), and make the first pieces yourself. Once the
format works, you turn it into a repeatable skill and hand it over. Do it once by hand. Then
build the thing that does it a hundred times.
A Month In, You're the Person Who Can
Walk into a client conversation, pull out what they really want, and leave with a production
spec.
Build the first version yourself, prove the creative works, then turn it into something that can
produce hundreds of videos without losing quality.
Turn that one-off into a pipeline: brief, references, key frames, shots, final video.
Keep entire scenes visually locked - same character, same environment, same cinematic
language - even across long sequences.
Direct AI models with prompts, references, and workflows that consistently deliver
production-ready shots.
Build workflows a client can run unattended on Frameo, pause, and pick back up without
losing work.
This Role Is for You If
You've gone beyond playing with AI, and built real systems people actually use.
You can talk about a lens or a camera move and say why, not just that it looks good.
You're happy in front of a client: running discovery, translating a brief, showing rough work
and taking the notes.
You write things down. Schemas, steps, gates. Because someone else has to run what you
make.



You've hit the real walls of generative video (drift, melted geometry, broken continuity) and
built your way around them.
You can hold a whole system in your head without being an engineer.
Nice to Have - Won't Hold It Against You If Not
Directing, cinematography, editing, or AD/Brand production
Client-facing or solutions-engineering background
A feel for structured data and schemas
Why You'll Love This Role
You'll work with the latest AI video models long before they become mainstream.
You'll have creative ownership from concept to execution - not just one piece of the pipeline.
You'll help define how brands create content in the AI era - and shape Frameo.ai's skill
library as one of its earliest creative architects.
You'll collaborate directly with ambitious clients and turn ideas into production-ready
systems.
Every project is different. Every workflow is something you invent.
To Apply
Send us at least one of the two: a showreel, or a workflow/pipeline you've built and run.
This is our first filter. No reel and no sample workflow means no next step. We want to see
consistency across shots, not a single hero clip.

Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines

Location: Pune We are seeking a passionate and innovative AI/ML Engineer / Data
Scientist to join our team and help design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready models.

Nustone is a leading UK supplier of porcelain paving, natural stone, wall cladding, garden products and outdoor living materials, serving customers through a strong ecommerce and digital presence.

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Lead to drive profitable digital growth, with a strong focus on SEO, AI-led marketing, paid acquisition and ecommerce performance.
